kind: authored replacements for the 50 particle rows the W13b audit withdrew (rule te-locution-withdraw)
scope: One row per withdrawn (key, position). Every one of these て tokens is the right half of a compound postposition (として / について / によって / にとって / に対して / に関して / に基づいて / から〜にかけて / を通して), not the conjunctive て the withdrawn template claimed. The explanation names the locution, gives the sense THIS sentence uses, and quotes the token the locution attaches to.

how_to_apply.explanation_pt: set to new_explanation; explanation_status becomes 'authored' (it was set to 'author' by the withdrawal)
how_to_apply.note: The audit table left function_pt_change as 'none' for these 50 rows, so the label is still the pair modal 'partícula conectiva (forma て)'. That label is as wrong as the withdrawn text was: these て are locution material. Applying new_function_pt overwrites no verified verdict, since all 50 carry function_status 'bank-modal'.

fields.locution: the compound postposition this て closes (bookkeeping; not learner-facing)
fields.why: authoring note, present only where the sense chosen is not the default reading of the locution

rows.new_function_pt: partícula fixa da locução 〜について (sobre, a respeito de)

rows.jp: 農民は常に天気について不満を言う。

rows.new_explanation: て fecha a locução について (sobre, a respeito de) e prende 何 ao resto: o que se pergunta é justamente sobre o que a matéria trata.

rows.jp: その組織について何か聞いたことはありますか。
